Generated Narrative: CodeSystem devicealert-presence

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/devicealert-presence defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
on OnThe signal is annunciated due to the presence of the alert condition
latched LatchedThe signal is annunciated after the alert condition is no longer present, until it is stopped by deliberate operator action
off OffThe signal is not being annunciated and the alert condition is no longer present
ack AcknowledgedThe signal is no longer annunciated having been stopped by deliberate operator action although the alert condition is still present

name: DeviceAlertPresence
title: Device Alert Presence
description: Describes the Presence of a DeviceAlert.
